findings.claim: Percent-decoded control characters were accepted by the SEC URL canonicalizer.
findings.evidence: src/sec10k/web/edgar_url.py decoded `%00`, `%0A`, `%0D`, and `%7F` only after the original-input control check, then returned a canonical URL containing the decoded control. Delta review caught `%7F` after the first repair covered only C0.
findings.repro: The edgar-viewer-url case failed first on `%00`, `%0A`, and `%0D`, then independently failed on `%7F` before the final repair.
findings.acceptance: Reject every ASCII C0 or DEL control character after decoding at the URL trust boundary.
findings.verification: VERIFIED — `%00/%0A/%0D/%7F` reject; no final-delta or base-integration finding
